page.layout: One page of text, full width, with a short italic reference line below it. No margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, gathering signature at the foot.

p.i: (hoc vobis praedico, quemadmodum jam praedixi) ij[?] divinum regnum non obtinebunt. At spiritus fructus, est charitas, gaudium, pax, clemētia, benignitas, bonitas, fides, lenitas, cōtinentia. Contra talia non est lex. Qui sunt autem Christi, ij[?] carnem una cum libidinibus & cupiditatibus crucifixerunt. Si spiritu vivimus, etiam spiritu gradiamur, ne simus gloriosi, invicem provocantes, invicem invidentes.

page.notes: The "ij" before "divinum" and before "Christi" is a printed mark, perhaps an abbreviation for "qui"; I have kept it as printed and marked it doubtful. The signature "Kk" is followed by a mark that may be a long s or an f; I have marked it doubtful. The opening bracket before "At" is a printed mark. The tilde over "e" in "clemētia" and over "o" in "cōtinentia" is the printed macron for a left-out n.
